VERDICT: FAIL

The response fails to strictly comply with the explicit constraints of a haiku. A standard haiku requires a 5-7-5 syllable structure. The provided poem has the following syllable counts:
1. "Tiny hands grasp the hour" (6 syllables: Ti-ny hands grasp the hour)
2. "Soft breaths echo through days and silently" (10 syllables: Soft breaths e-cho through days and si-lent-ly)
3. "Time cradles their soft dreams" (6 syllables: Time cra-dles their soft dreams)

Since the syllable count is 6-10-6 rather than 5-7-5, it does not meet the formal definition of a haiku.
